scope: Ten country/region packs: six inherited adaptations plus FRA, TWN, HKG and SGP. Four new packs selected from observed aggregate audience and search demand; visitor location is never treated as an individual birthplace or used to force gameplay choices.
limits: Institutions establish possible settings, not access guarantees, uniform national culture, household language, government endorsement or future policy. No statistics copied from older sources. Dialogue, characters, motives and outcomes are original fiction. Country adaptations share prototype branch outcomes; they are not 30 independent cultural ethnographies. Native editorial review remains desirable before expanding.
